title: Design System: Old MacDonald Had a School

body.purpose: Readable paragraphs, instructions, labels, and controls.

hand.purpose: Short teacher cue, quote, or reminder.

shadows.name: working-wall-support
shadows.value: inset 0 0 0 .35rem color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-paper) 72%, transparent), 0 .65rem 1.25rem color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-ink) 18%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Separates an installed working-wall support from its environment.

shadows.name: paper-lift
shadows.value: 0 .3rem 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-wood) 32%, transparent), 0 .65rem 1rem color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-ink) 13%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Lifts readable paper one plane above its support.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keeps keyboard focus visible above decorative layers.

shadows.name: grade-tab-hover
shadows.purpose: Signals hover on a grade-owned surface.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Controls transform, shadow, and background feedback on interactive surfaces.

motion.name: reduced-motion-duration
motion.purpose: Removes nonessential animation when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Shared default action with a readable 44 px touch height and semantic focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: .5rem 1rem; border: .14rem solid var(--primary); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 800 1rem/1.7 var(--font-farm-body, Nunito, sans-serif); transition: transform 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out, background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 .35rem .55rem color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-ink) 20%, transparent); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Paper Card
components.description: Readable live content lifted one plane above its supporting surface.
components.html:
Learning purpose

Notice, test, make, explain, and share.
components.css: .ds-paper-card { padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); background-color: var(--brand-paper, var(--card)); color: var(--brand-paper-foreground, var(--card-foreground)); background-image: var(--asset-cardboard-ivory); background-repeat: repeat; background-size: 320px; box-shadow: 0 .3rem 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-wood) 32%, transparent), 0 .65rem 1rem color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-ink) 13%, transparent); transition: transform 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-paper-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-paper-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Daycare Grade Surface Chip
components.description: Grade-owned Daycare routing surface using Miss Puddles' exact identity color and approved dark foreground.
components.css: .ds-grade-surface-chip[data-grade="daycare"] { --grade-color: var(--grade-daycare-color, #F6AF32); --grade-ink: #1E2A38; min-height: 44px; padding: .5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--grade-color) 55%, var(--theme-wood-light)); border-inline-start: .35rem solid var(--grade-color); border-radius: var(--radius-xl); background-color: var(--grade-color); background-image: linear-gradient(var(--grade-color), var(--grade-color)), var(--grade-texture); background-blend-mode: color, normal; color: var(--grade-ink); box-shadow: 0 .25rem 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--grade-color) 72%, black); transition: transform 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out, background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-grade-surface-chip:hover, .ds-grade-surface-chip:focus-visible { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 .35rem .55rem color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-ink) 20%, transparent); } .ds-grade-surface-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Shared readable paper field for teacher-facing search.
components.css: .ds-search-input { min-height: 44px; width: 100%; padding: .5rem 1rem; border: .14rem solid var(--input); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); font: 400 1rem/1.7 var(--font-farm-body, Nunito, sans-serif); transition: border-color 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-search-input:hover { border-color: var(--border); } .ds-search-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Mr Rusty Character Badge
components.description: Unchanged canonical face patch on Mr Rusty's exact identity surface.
components.css: .ds-character-badge.characters-mr-rusty { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; inline-size: 44px; block-size: 44px; overflow: hidden; border: .14rem solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--characters-mr-rusty-color, #267CBA) 42%, transparent); border-radius: 50%; background-color: var(--characters-mr-rusty-color, #267CBA); background-image: linear-gradient(var(--characters-mr-rusty-color, #267CBA), var(--characters-mr-rusty-color, #267CBA)), var(--characters-mr-rusty-texture); background-blend-mode: color, normal; color: var(--characters-mr-rusty-foreground, #FEFCE8); transition: transform 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-character-badge img { inline-size: 100%; block-size: 100%; object-fit: cover; } .ds-character-badge:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 .35rem .55rem color-mix(in srgb, var(--theme-ink) 20%, transparent); } .ds-character-badge:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
This system translates the official character record into a framework-neutral contract for websites, presentations, printable resources, editorial pages, and other generated artifacts.

It serves an educator-facing curriculum product. Its job is to make a specific learning purpose and the practical material needed to lead it easy to understand at a glance. The visual world is not children’s entertainment and not a generic dashboard: it is a welcoming, capable working environment for planning and leading real learning experiences.

rules.name: The One Semantic Owner Rule
rules.body: Character color and felt belong only to that character. Grade color belongs to that grade. Subject color and icon belong to curriculum meaning. Generic navigation and controls use shared semantic UI roles, never character texture.

rules.name: The Credible Attachment Rule
rules.body: A fastener must cross artifact and support.

dos: Do use exact approved identity colors and canonical art from this file.
Do put readable information on paper.
Do keep content live across media.
Do preserve all assets pending explicit classification.
Do keep the complete character record in this file only; pages render it, they do not redefine it.
donts: Don't treat cork as the whole design concept.
Don't use a floating decorative fastener.
Don't put paragraphs or controls on fabric.
Don't assign character felt to generic navigation or subjects.
Don't shrink dimensional art into compact UI.
Don't bake responsive text into images.
Don't infer authority from other Markdown files or file availability.
Don't exclude or substitute an image without approval.
Don't maintain character, grade, or subject color data in any file other than this one and its two CSS bindings.
